title: One-click demo import with undo
problem: Starting a good-looking store meant setting everything by hand; there were no ready demos to begin from.
now: Signal, Nokshi and Counter can be previewed with the shop's own products and imported part by part; a restore point undoes it in one click.
steps: Open Online Store › Theme and press Preview on Nokshi, switch to Phone
Press Import, tick Menus too and read What will be replaced
Import, then open the store: the fashion look shows
Back on Theme, press Go back on Before importing Nokshi
notes: Where: Online Store › Theme (/theme) · Presets and Restore points

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
